svg.desc: Escape from Tarkov's Lighthouse as of September 2026 in tarkov.dev's flat map style. Layout from Jindouz's Lighthouse 2D map (EFT Wiki), placed on the game's own coordinates using its loot spots; causeway and jetty drawn over it; minefields from the game's data via tarkov.dev; style and map border from the tarkov.dev SVG maps (the-hideout/tarkov-dev-svg-maps, Shebuka and contributors). Licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Not for use in cheating software.
